eips.title: Remove `deposit` and `eth1data` fields
eips.summary: SFI'd for Hegota as a small change cleaning up deposit and eth1data fields from beacon state.

moments.context: Barnabas proposed SFI'ing EIP-8015 immediately, noting it is already merged into the Heze spec and being tested.
Discussion returned to EIP-8015; stokes confirmed no opposition and formally moved it to SFI for Hegota.

eips.title: Disallow new 0x00 validators
eips.summary: Barnabas proposed changes to avoid burning ETH for 0x00 deposits after the fork; decision deferred to next call.

moments.context: Barnabas raised EIP-8365 (disallow new 0x00 validators), presenting his proposal to avoid burning ETH by routing deposits back through the activation queue instead.
Discussion on whether to burn ETH or keep it via Barnabas' activation-gate approach; NC argued for protocol simplicity, Barnabas argued against burning.
Stokes summarized the split opinion and deferred the decision to the next call, suggesting in-person discussion at Devcon.

eips.title: Bundled Attestation Propagation
eips.summary: CFI'd for Hegota after Sukun presented bandwidth savings from bundled attestation propagation simulations.

moments.context: Sukun presented simulation results showing EIP-8334 halves attestation bandwidth for home nodes, critical for decoupled consensus in ISTAR.
Lighthouse and Teku expressed support; Grandine and Lodestar were more cautious. Potuz noted attestation bandwidth is the most important topic to tackle.
Stokes called for CFI; multiple client teams gave thumbs up in chat and EIP-8334 was moved to CFI.

eips.title: Reduce CL Block Retention Window
eips.summary: CFI'd for Hegota as a single config value change reducing the CL block retention window.

moments.context: Kev confirmed the EIP is ready for consideration as a single value change reducing the retention window, building on alignment work done in Gloas.
Lighthouse, Lodestar, and others expressed support for CFI in chat; Nico noted the exact value should be revisited but favored inclusion.
No opposition raised; stokes moved EIP-8383 to CFI.

eips.title: Execution-Layer Reorg State Retention Window
eips.summary: Kev cited it as a related EIP for the reorg state retention window that also uses the 8192 value.

moments.context: Kev referenced EIP-8252 by Toni as a related retention window EIP that also uses the 8192 epoch value, suggesting alignment.

eips.title: Withdrawal credentials preregistration
eips.summary: DFI'd for Hegota; core devs committed to solving the deposit front-running issue with the post-quantum deposit redesign instead.

moments.context: Dima proposed CFI'ing EIP-8205 as a backstop until PQ solves front-running, noting neither current PQ deposit proposal addresses it.
Potuz argued the complexity should wait for PQ when the deposit flow will change anyway; Dima countered that DFI risks the issue never being solved.
Greg K argued for at least a commitment that the issue will be solved in PQ. Stokes concluded by DFI'ing EIP-8205 but recording a strong commitment to resolve it with PQ.

eips.title: Decouple Stake from Validator Registration
eips.summary: Kev cited it as the PQ proposal that decouples stake from validator registration but does not solve front-running.

moments.context: Kev identified EIP-8413 as one of the two PQ deposit proposals, noting it disincentivizes but does not solve the front-running issue.

eips.title: Custom sweep threshold for validators
eips.summary: CFI'd for Hegota after Dima presented the benefits of custom sweep thresholds and pointed to a working proof of concept credited to Manu.

moments.context: Dima presented EIP-8148 allowing validators to set a custom sweep threshold between 32 and 2048 ETH, arguing it would drive consolidations and unify withdrawal credential types.

Manu, whom Dima had credited for the proof of concept, said the spec is easy to understand and the consensus-layer implementation straightforward and low-complexity, and pointed to his own proof of concept in DORA.
Lighthouse said they would not block if others favor it; stokes moved EIP-8148 to CFI after seeing broad support.

eips.title: Execution layer triggerable withdrawals
eips.summary: Referenced as an existing system contract design analogous to the one proposed in EIP-8148.

moments.context: Dima compared the EIP-8148 system contract to the existing contracts used for EIP-7002 and EIP-7251.

eips.title: Increase the MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE
eips.summary: Referenced alongside EIP-7002 as an existing system contract similar to EIP-8148's proposed contract.

moments.context: Dima noted the EIP-8148 system contract is not much different from those used for EIP-7002 or EIP-7251.

eips.title: Fast Execution Payload Broadcast
eips.summary: CFI'd for Hegota after Kamil presented simulations showing 3x faster payload propagation via chunked shard broadcasting.

moments.context: Kamil presented EIP-8411 (fast execution payload broadcast), showing simulations with 4000 nodes demonstrating at least 3x propagation improvement by chunking payloads.
Multiple client teams expressed CFI support in chat; Potuz called for SFI. Stokes formally moved EIP-8411 to CFI.

eips.title: Hardware and Bandwidth Recommendations
eips.summary: Referenced as the hardware and bandwidth recommendation baseline used in EIP-8411 simulations.

moments.context: Kamil mentioned his simulations used EIP-7870 hardware recommendations with 4000 nodes.
